entities.name: Osiris
entities.effect: Return up to two target creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield. Gain 4 life.
entities.lore: Green-skinned lord of the dead and rightful kings.

entities.name: Horus
entities.effect: Target creature gains +3/+3 and Flying until end of turn. Draw a card.
entities.lore: Falcon sky-god, avenger of Osiris.

entities.name: Set
entities.effect: Destroy target creature or artifact. Each opponent discards a card.
entities.lore: Ambiguous lord of deserts and thunder.

entities.name: Nephthys
entities.effect: Creatures you control gain Hexproof until your next turn. Create a 1/1 Spirit with Flying.
entities.lore: Sister of Isis who guards the dead at night.

entities.name: Thoth
entities.effect: Draw 3 cards. You may return a card from your graveyard to your hand.
entities.lore: Ibis-scribe who speaks the measure of the cosmos.

entities.name: Bastet
entities.effect: Create a 2/2 Cat token with Ward 2. Gain 3 life.
entities.lore: Cat goddess who purrs with pleasant might.

entities.name: Sekhmet
entities.effect: Deal 4 damage to each other creature. You gain life equal to the number destroyed.
entities.lore: Lioness of blazing deserts and scourge of battle.

entities.name: Ptah
entities.effect: Create two 1/1 Construct tokens. Return target artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
entities.lore: Artisan who speaks worlds into form.

entities.name: Hathor
entities.effect: Gain 5 life. Draw a card. Your next Invocation costs 2 less.
entities.lore: Golden cow of jubilation and nurturing.

entities.name: Ma'at
entities.effect: Each player draws 2 cards, then discards 1. Exile target permanent with mana cost 4+.
entities.lore: Feather of truth that balances every soul.

entities.name: Sobek
entities.effect: Target creature you control gets +3/+0 and Trample this turn. Create a Food token.
entities.lore: Crocodile lord who rises with flood.

entities.name: Khnum
entities.effect: Create a 1/1 Clay Golem token; put a +1/+1 counter on up to two target creatures.
entities.lore: Ram-headed shaper of flesh upon the wheel.

entities.name: Khepri
entities.effect: Transform target creature you control into a copy of another target creature until end of turn. Draw a card.
entities.lore: Scarab who rolls the sun into the day.

entities.name: Wadjet
entities.effect: Target creature gains Hexproof and Deathtouch until end of turn.
entities.lore: Uraeus who spits fire to guard the crown.

entities.name: Nekhbet
entities.effect: Target creature gains Flying and Ward 2 until end of turn. Scry 1.
entities.lore: Vulture-mother shielding the throne.

entities.name: Tefnut
entities.effect: Tap up to two permanents. Deal 2 damage to any target.
entities.lore: Lioness of dew and sudden squalls.

entities.name: Shu
entities.effect: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. Scry 2.
entities.lore: Bearer of the sky who parts earth from heaven.

entities.name: Geb
entities.effect: Search your library for a basic land and put it onto the battlefield tapped; put a +1/+1 counter on up to two creatures.
entities.lore: Green earth whose laughter makes quakes.

entities.name: Nut
entities.effect: Creatures you control gain Ward 1. Draw a card for each legendary you control (max 2).
entities.lore: Starry vault that swallows the sun each night.

entities.name: Hapi
entities.effect: Create a Food token and a Treasure token. Gain 2 life.
entities.lore: Spirit of the life-giving flood.

entities.name: Serqet
entities.effect: Destroy target creature with power 2 or less. You gain 3 life.
entities.lore: Scorpion guardian of venom and cure.

entities.name: Seshat
entities.effect: Look at the top five cards of your library; put two into your hand and the rest on bottom.
entities.lore: Architect of lines and scribe of plans.

entities.name: Wepwawet
entities.effect: Create a 2/1 Jackal token with Haste and "can't be blocked by more than one creature".
entities.lore: Jackal who opens paths through unknown lands.

entities.name: Montu
entities.effect: Creatures you control gain +2/+0 and Trample until end of turn. Create a 3/3 Bull token.
entities.lore: Bull-warrior whose standard leads armies.

entities.name: Bes
entities.effect: Target creature gains Ward 2; create a Food token. Draw a card.
entities.lore: Dwarf-guardian who dances away dread.

entities.name: Amun
entities.effect: Exile target nonland permanent. Create two Treasure tokens. Draw a card.
entities.lore: Invisible king whose breath moves the world.

entities.name: Aten
entities.effect: Deal 6 damage divided as you choose among any number of targets. You gain 6 life. Your next Invocation costs 3 less.
entities.lore: Blazing disk whose rays end in hands.
